summary: Innovative Food Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that Sam Klepfish exercised a previously disclosed right to become a Board Observer on May 20, 2026, after ceasing to be a director, triggered by his 3%+ share ownership. The Board Observer attends meetings in a non-voting capacity with access to materials, subject to confidentiality. No deal terms or financial consideration are involved. This is a governance arrangement, not a special situation transaction.
